resources.string: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance, PC version. You need your own PC copy (the folder with the .exe and GameData). The game code in this app is only decrypted with your executable.
The app needs \"All files access\" to read the game folder (internal storage or SD card).
Looks for \"%1$s\" in MGRPC/, MGR/ or Games/MGR/ on each storage volume.
This executable is not the supported version (expected SHA-1 %1$s…). The game code cannot be decrypted with it.
The game options are written again before launching. In game, the Back button opens the menu.
Recommended for this device: %1$s. Changing any option switches to Custom.
Percentage of the native screen resolution (%1$s), same aspect ratio. The screen (or FSR / CAS) scales the image up.
Above 60 only helps on screens with a high refresh rate.
The screen stretches the internal resolution (simple bilinear).
AMD FSR 1 in DXVK: edge-aware scaling to the output, then RCAS sharpening. Two passes at output size.
Contrast adaptive sharpening with a simple scale in a single pass: lighter than FSR 1.

Shows a generated frame between every two game frames (game at 30 fps, screen at 60 Hz). The motion is estimated from the two frames; on scene cuts or failures the frame is repeated or blended. One more frame of latency.
Requires the 30 fps limit: turning it on sets the limit to 30, and choosing another limit turns it off.
The same as OPTIONS > GRAPHIC OPTIONS in the game, written to the game\'s GraphicOption file (read when the game starts).
Could not save the game options in %1$s: %2$s
If the SD card does not accept writes by path, give the app access to the game folder through the system picker: the options are then written through it.
Give access to the game folder
On-screen buttons and sticks (editable layout). A quick tap outside the buttons is a mouse click in the game menus.
No buttons on screen (only the menu button). Left half: drag = move. Right half: tap = light attack, long press = strong attack, swipe = camera, two fingers = Blade Mode.
No buttons on screen (only the menu button). Your finger is the game mouse: drag = camera, tap = click.
A physical controller always works, in any mode.
Also available in game: menu > Edit controls.
One tap enters Blade Mode and another leaves it (instead of holding).
The game stops while the in-game menu or the editor is open.
GPU: %1$s. \"System\" uses the device driver; the others are installed in this app.
AdrenoTools packages (Turnip for Adreno). The driver is never changed automatically.
The package has no driver library
This driver needs a newer Android
This driver is not for this GPU
The game threads run in parallel (about +40% fps in fights). If the game freezes or closes, turn it off.
The game is paused while this menu is open.
Exiting closes the game without saving: use the game\'s own save first.
Launcher for the PC version of Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance on Android: the game\'s x86 code is statically recompiled to ARM64 and Direct3D 9 goes to Vulkan through DXVK.
This app is separate from Zandatsu (Xbox 360 version): its own settings, drivers and control layouts.
Graphics: DXVK with FSR 1 / CAS and 30 → 60 frame generation. Alternative Vulkan drivers through libadrenotools.
No game files are included. Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance is a trademark of its owners; this project is not affiliated with them.
